keywords.name: Flying
keywords.description: This creatures can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.

keywords.name: First Strike
keywords.description: This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.

keywords.name: Double Strike
keywords.description: This creature deals combat damage twice during each combat phase.

keywords.name: Deathtouch
keywords.description: Any amount of damage dealt by this creature to another creature is lethal.

keywords.name: Trample
keywords.description: If this creature is blocked, you may have it deal excess combat damage to the defending player or planeswalker.

keywords.name: Vigilance
keywords.description: This creature doesn't tap to attack.

keywords.name: Menace
keywords.description: This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.

keywords.name: Reach
keywords.description: This creature can block creatures with flying.

keywords.name: Lifelink
keywords.description: When this creature deals damage, you gain that much life.

keywords.name: Haste
keywords.description: This creature can attack and tap during the turn it comes into play.

keywords.name: Hexproof
keywords.description: This creature can't be targeted by spells or abilities controlled by your opponents.

keywords.name: Indestructible
keywords.description: This creature can't be destroyed by damage or effects that say 'destroy'.

keywords.name: Ward 2
keywords.description: Opponents must pay 2 colorless, to target this creature.

keywords.name: Skulk
keywords.description: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.

keywords.name: Shadow
keywords.description: This creature can only be blocked and block by other creatures with Shadow.

keywords.name: Bushido 1
keywords.description: This creature get +1/+1 if it is blocking or blocked.

keywords.name: Prowess
keywords.description: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn whenever a noncreature spell is cast.

keywords.name: Melee
keywords.description: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attack this turn.

keywords.name: Infect
keywords.description: This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.

keywords.name: Exalted
keywords.description: Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each permanent with exalted under your control.

keywords.name: Convoke
keywords.description: Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature's color.

keywords.name: Evoke 2
keywords.description: You may cast this spell for 2 colorless. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters the battlefield.

keywords.name: Fabricate 2
keywords.description: When this creature enters the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on it or create two 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature token.

keywords.name: Undying
keywords.description: When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to its owner's hand.

keywords.name: Persist
keywords.description: When this creature dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to its owner's hand.

keywords.name: Annihilator 1
keywords.description: Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices a permanent.

keywords.name: Wither
keywords.description: This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.

keywords.name: Cascade
keywords.description: When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.

keywords.name: Defender
keywords.description: This creature can't attack.

keywords.name: Shroud
keywords.description: This creature can't be targeted by spells or abilities.

keywords.name: Flash
keywords.description: You may cast this creature any time you could cast an instant.

keywords.name: Toxic 1
keywords.description: When this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets a poison counter.

keywords.name: Backup 1
keywords.description: When this creature enters the battlefield, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and all printed abilities of this creature until end of turn.

keywords.name: Firebending 1
keywords.description: When this creature attacks add 1 red mana to your mana pool.

keywords.name: Offspring 3
keywords.description: When you cast this spell you may pay 3. If you do, when it enters create a 1/1 token that's a copy of this creature
